findings.criterion: [operator-attested] a full writing reconcile pass (`bootstrap-strict`) against the J5 harness converges with no unhandled exception — covering tests `test_a_repeated_dc_reconcile_pass_writes_nothing` and `test_a_dc_created_ticket_carries_the_shared_jira_provenance` both pass
findings.detail: The only live-run attestation in the ticket is run 30637886718 (comment 'LIVE RUN 30637886718 — THE FIX WORKS'). That comment explicitly reports '2 failed, 12 passed, 1 error' — the two named tests DID NOT PASS. The comment explains the failures were due to a test defect (using `_envelope()` in writing mode) that was then corrected, but no subsequent run attestation is recorded showing the tests passing after the correction. The criterion requires the named tests to pass; the only attested run shows them failing.
findings.remediation: Record a follow-up ticket comment citing a CI run ID where `test_a_repeated_dc_reconcile_pass_writes_nothing` and `test_a_dc_created_ticket_carries_the_shared_jira_provenance` both PASS (exit 0, no 'Traceback' in stderr, convergence line in stdout), naming the run URL/ID and the observed test counts.
